items.author: cuichen
items.descZh: Papilot 是一个面向学术论文审阅的类 Cursor 工作空间，旨在让用户直接在 PDF 上进行标注和修改，完全无需接触 LaTeX 源码。其核心流程是：用户像导师批阅草稿一样在 PDF 上圈选句子或公式并说明修改意见，系统通过 SyncTeX 技术将标注精确映射到对应的 LaTeX 代码行，再由 AI 代理自动执行编辑。编辑结果会以排版后的“before-and-after”页面对比形式返回，用户可以逐条审批、拒绝或评论，只有被接受的修改才会真正生效，确保修改权完全掌握在用户手中。亮点在于它将 PDF 标注、AI 自动改稿和版本控制无缝整合，提供真实的 PDF 阅读体验，包括目录跳转、全文搜索和精确文本选取，并支持 Git 提交与协作合并。该工具特别适合需要反复修改论文的研究生、导师以及协作审稿的学术团队，能显著降低 LaTeX 排版的技术门槛。原文未提供具体的性能数字。
items.quote: 你像主管批改草稿一样在 PDF 上做标记，AI 代理在 LaTeX 中执行修改，每次改动都会以前后对比的形式返回给你。
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：一个类似 Cursor 的 LaTeX 论文工作区

items.title: Show HN: Supply chain security for open source maintainers
items.desc: description: Open source projects get the full SafeDep Team plan for free, with 10 seats. Catch malicious packages and risky dependencies before they reach your users. title: SafeDep for Open Source: Free Supply Chain Security for Maintainers image: https://safedep.io/_astro/default.XKjD304M_xWhE3.webp SafeDep for Open Source Supply chain security for open source maintainers. Maintainers are now a prime target for malicious packages and hijacked dependencies. We give qualifying open source projects the full SafeDep Team plan for free, with 10 seats for your maintainers. [ Apply for free ](https://app.safedep.io/oss/apply)[ See what's included ](included) The story Why we are doing this Open source is what everyone builds on. The people who maintain it deserve the same protection that large companies pay for. Why open source maintainers are now a target What SafeDep catches before it reaches your users How the program works for your project Watch the story Maintainers are the new target. Most have no security team. Attackers publish lookalike packages, take over maintainer accounts and slip malicious code into dependencies. When one popular project is hit, everyone downstream is hit too. Most maintainers protect millions of users in their spare time. What you get Everything in the Team plan.Free for your project. No cut down edition and no feature gates. Approved projects get the same plan that paying teams use. Malicious package protection Every dependency is checked against SafeDep threat intelligence. Known bad packages are caught before they land in your project. Pull request checks The SafeDep GitHub App reviews new and changed dependencies on every pull request, so you never have to read a lockfile diff by hand. Protection on maintainer machines PMG blocks malicious installs on the laptops and CI runners your maintainers use, and syncs every event to your SafeDep tenant. Policies and findings in one place See findings across every repository in your project and set the rules once for all of them. 90 day history and audit trail Look back at what was flagged, what was blocked and when, for the last 90 days. Ondemand scans Scan any package or repository on demand when something looks off, with a monthly allowance included. 10 seats for your maintainers 12 months, renewable No credit card Email support Who qualifies Built for real open source projects You do not need thousands of stars. We look for projects that are open, maintained and used by other people. What we require A public repository on GitHub An OSI approved license, such as MIT, Apache 2.0, GPL, BSD or MPL Active maintenance, with at least one commit in the last 90 days At least 3 months old, and not a fork or a mirror You maintain it, which we confirm when you connect the SafeDep GitHub App Run by its community, not the open core edition of a commercial product What helps your application Published to a package registry like npm, PyPI, Go, Maven or crates.io Real usage, such as downloads or projects that depend on it More than one active contributor A healthy OpenSSF Scorecard Part of a foundation such as CNCF, Apache, OpenJS or the Linux Foundation Not sure your project fits? Apply anyway. How it works Three steps, no paperwork 1. 01 Apply Sign in to SafeDep, connect the GitHub App to your project and tell us a little about it. It takes a few minutes. 2. 02 We review We review every application and get back to you by email as soon as we can. 3. 03 You are covered Approved projects get the Team plan with 10 seats for 12 months. We renew it as long as the project still qualifies. FAQ Questions maintainers ask Is it really free? \+ Yes. There is no credit card and no trial that turns into a bill. Approved projects get the full Team plan at no cost. What exactly do we get? \+ Everything in the SafeDep Team plan, with 10 seats for your maintainers and core contributors. No features are held back. Why do I need to apply? \+ The Team plan covers repositories, CI and developer machines. A quick review makes sure each grant goes to a real open source project and not to private company code. What if we need more than 10 seats? \+ Tell us in your application or reach out after you are approved. We look at larger projects case by case. What happens after 12 months? \+ We check that the project still qualifies and renew the grant. If it no longer does, we let you know before anything changes. Can we use it on private repositories? \+ The program is for your open source work. Using it on private company code goes against the program terms and can end the grant. A company backs our project. Can we still apply? \+ If the project is run by its community, yes. Open core projects where a company sells the paid edition are not covered, but we are happy to [talk about other options](https://calendly.com/abhiseksafedep/30min). Do you ask for anything in return? \+ No. If SafeDep helps your project, a "Secured by SafeDep" badge in your README or a mention is appreciated, but never required. Protecting the people who protect open source. Apply in a few minutes. We will get back to you as soon as we can. [ Apply for free ](https://app.safedep.io/oss/apply)[ Talk to us ](https://calendly.com/abhiseksafedep/30min) We value your privacy SafeDep keeps analytics anonymous and cookiefree until you opt in. Accepting helps us understand product usage and improve your experience. [Privacy Policy](/privacy) Accept all Reject all Preferences Choose what you share. You can change this anytime from the footer. Essential Always on Remembers your cookie choice and keeps the site secure. Cannot be switched off. Analytics PostHog + Google Analytics. Page views, feature usage and CTA clicks to improve the product. Save preferences Back
items.author: tech_solver
items.descZh: 随着开源维护者成为恶意包和依赖劫持的首要目标，SafeDep 推出免费开源计划，为符合条件的项目提供完整的 Team 版安全套件，配备多达 10 个维护者席位。该方案核心在于全链条供应链安全防护，通过威胁情报实时检测恶意依赖，并在 GitHub 拉取请求阶段自动审查新变更依赖。亮点在于其企业级防护能力下沉，不仅提供维护者设备端的恶意安装拦截，还支持 90 天历史追溯与按需扫描，且无任何功能阉割。该计划面向活跃、社区驱动的真实开源项目，仅需三步流程且无需信用卡，获批后可获得 12 个月可续期的全面安全保护，极大降低了开源社区的防御门槛。

items.title: Show HN: Real Time AI Heat Map Sourced from over 140 News Feeds
items.desc: description: An interactive heat map of the AI companies, models, products, people and ideas getting the most attention in AI news over the last 7 days. Updated continuously from 125+ sources. title: Jag's AI Heat Map — a live map of trending AI news image: https://ainews.jagular.io/ogimage.png × Explore the map Scroll to zoom Drag to pan Click a node for details × × About Jag's AI Heat Map An interactive map of the AI companies, models, products, people, hardware and ideas that are getting the most attention in AI news and developer communities. Bigger, closer to the centre and more connected means more talked about. Browse the articles The Articles button (top right) opens a scrollable archive of every article behind the map — the last 90 days, grouped by source, newest first. Pick a source on the left to see just its stories; click any headline to open it in a new tab. The small red number under the button counts how many new articles were discovered in the last hour. How heat works Every story adds heat to each entity it mentions, weighted by source and popularity (Hacker News points, Hugging Face upvotes, GitHub stars). Heat cools with a 24\hour halflife, so the map reflects the last few days of a 7day window. Links join entities that appear in the same stories. Week covers 7 days with a 24hour halflife; Today covers 24 hours with a 6hour halflife and compares with 6 hours earlier. Breaking (orange name, pulsing ring) means an entity got at least 2 stories and 2.5× more attention in the last 6 hours than in the 6 hours before. New (orange ring) marks entities first spotted this week; ↑ means heat is at least 1.5× what it was 24 hours earlier, ↓ that it has cooled. Topics are drawn as diamonds; the hottest topic is filled orange and its closest connections are outlined. Sources this run Built independently; inspired by [AI MAP by carlwow](https://aimap.goodcase.ai). Not affiliated with any company shown. Graph rendering by [D3](https://d3js.org) (ISC licence). items.descZh: 该项目旨在调查API密钥、令牌和密码等秘密泄露到编码代理的频率，背景是随着AI编码工具的普及，秘密泄露风险日益凸显。核心功能是提供一份匿名数据报告，详细统计开发者的代理看到秘密的次数、秘密类型（如密钥或密码）、泄露方式（如手动粘贴或工具自动拉入），并按工具和国家进行分类分析。亮点在于第一版报告将在收集满200名开发者数据后发布，预计于2026年第四季度面世，目前已有5名参与者贡献数据，还需195人即可解锁；报告将基于大规模样本，提供具体的泄露频率和分布数字，例如按工具细分的泄露率。适用场景包括开发者个人用于自检安全实践、企业安全团队评估风险，以及工具提供商优化设计，以预防敏感信息暴露。

items.descZh: 本文作者 Casper 针对当前开发者在构建网站和应用时面临的工具需求与高昂 SaaS 订阅预算之间的矛盾，分享了一套高性价比的自研工具集。该工具核心功能在于提供开发网站和应用所需的关键辅助工具，帮助用户摆脱对昂贵单一 SaaS 服务的依赖。其核心亮点是显著降低了开发成本，让预算有限的个人开发者和初创团队无需为每个环节支付高额订阅费，实现了开发工具的高效整合。该方案主要适用于预算紧张但开发需求旺盛的个人创业者、小型团队，用于高效、低成本地推动项目从开发到上线。通过共享这些工具，作者旨在为 Hacker News 社区及其他开发者社区提供切实可行的成本优化方案，促进技术共享。
